regions.label: INesHeader
regions.evidence: iNES magic, PRG/CHR sizes and mapper fields verified by inspect; 16-byte physical header.

regions.label: InterruptVectors
regions.evidence: Three little-endian vector words $81f9/$8000/$8000, matching reset/NMI instruction contracts.

regions.label: ChrTiles
regions.evidence: iNES CHR extent: four 8 KiB CNROM pattern banks, 16-byte 2bpp PPU tiles; CPU code cannot map this storage.

regions.label: MainStateHandlers
regions.evidence: Main dispatcher $8051-$805b reads word pair $822c+2*RAM[$14], indirect JMP. Exact endpoint at reset helper $825a; 23 coherent state handlers return to $8047. Natural selection of every state unproven.
